**The main setting, the heart of this game, is the City of Otti, a fictional, cold, and emotionally distant city, plagued with problems and unhappiness. The player’s journey focuses on how to change the city for the better. 

In the background of this lies lore and story, origins of this fictional world if you will, and what some characters in the narrative believe in. 

The game’s background lore roughly takes the Gnostic myth of Creation, the myth of the Monad, as its starting point, which it further interprets. Instead of referring to it directly, this lore takes the basic structure of this medieval myth, The Monad and its Aeons, Sophia (Knowledge and the youngest Aeon) , and the Demiurge, and reimagines them. Values of the original myth are completely reversed. The Gnostics saw the material world as a prison, the universe an error. Instead, I propose a new type of myth, a twist on the existing. 

In the world of Sediment, its inhabitants believe a different sort of story. The reality we perceive is arguably our most important asset; the world is for us to mold. 

The High Potential is a central concept; it is not a place, a being, or a working mind, but rather a repository of all what-ifs that precede the existence of something. The sum of all energy and laws on which the universe operates, on the level of physics, mathematics… complete unity. Indifferent it its nature, not good or bad, simply complete. 

This Potential is the meta level, our physical world (of the game world, so in this case digital) is the Loom, and the concept of the Potential is directly linked to this real world.

**![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)**  **![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)**

**Let’s imagine the Loom, such as this one. A complex circular weaving machine, this is how the game’s characters envision the mechanisms of their reality, how it operates; this is their philosophy. The Potential (potential for anything in any form) expresses itself in the Loom (real world) through Patterns. Patterns are fundamental, abstract concepts that are the toolkit of reality. The first Patterns are fundamental things, such as time, matter, space, energy, connection… the baseline for the world, its rules. 

A different type of Pattern emerged after a while, this pattern is Sentience. The first one to become self-aware, aware of its state as a mere state of things, but this pattern was different in the sense that it was guided by a pure force, a will to exist or become. It saw all the other patterns and came to an idea: Why not join them all? 

This is how the game’s reality was made, Sentinece, the defiant and transgressive pattern, did the inverse, and broke the pattern by creating the world, a combination of all these abstract concepts and laws. In this sense, the biggest evil in defiance of these principles are ignorence and mindlessness, a state where a person avoids change in favor of predictability, entropy and refusing to grow.

**Sentience, thus, in the process of creating this world, exuded such amounts of energy that it shattered into countless fragments. All sentient life carries a fragment of Sentience. We are new thread, the Loom’s (world’s) way of observing and changing itself. 

All sentient life also carries Agency, the will to act upon things. This makes us the only parts of the world that can act against the automated. 

These concepts come together and communicate that the future is ever-changing, future is what we are willing to build here where we are. We are to take responsibility for the futures we build and leave to others. In this game, people seek higher meaning, this is it. Salvation is not heaven or somewhere else to escape to, rather the act of molding our reality, through it, seeking warmth over cold distance, even when it is the hard choice to make. Weaving a new fabric, if you will.
